Travels along a medium trajectory and sticks to surfaces, projecting a laser every ? seconds. Sticking to something other than a surface immediately triggers the Tripmine.

The Tripmine triggers when an enemy enters its scanning cone or after 10 seconds attached to a surface. The cone extends 10 meters from the mine and has a 7 meter radius.

It explodes 1 second after triggering, or immediately on being destroyed, dealing up to <pve 805 /> <pvp [140] /> damage and applying 40 stacks of <solar Scorch /> in a ? meter radius.

// The laser interval and explosion radius are unknown. The source does not identify the condition granting 20 additional Scorch stacks.

source.text:
Medium Trajectory | Wall-Mounted | Sticky

Attaches to surfaces, projecting a laser every ? seconds. Sticking to a non-surface immediately triggers the Tripmine.

Triggers after an enemy is within its scanning cone, or after being attached for 10 seconds.
Scanning Cone extends up to 10 meters away, with a radius of 7 meters.

Explodes after 1 second of triggering, or upon being destroyed, dealing up to 805 [140] damage and inflicting x40+20 Scorch over ? meters on detonation.
Base Cooldown: 159.6 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.625x
